tokens.name: cobalto
tokens.usage: Brand color. Logo, primary buttons, links, hero grounds. Text on it must be crema (6.0:1). As text or icon on crema or blanco it also holds 6.0:1.

tokens.name: tomate
tokens.usage: Accent. The extrusion of the p, the dot of the i, small highlights and tags. Text on it must be tinta (5.5:1). Never as text on crema or blanco (2.8:1).

tokens.name: mantequilla
tokens.usage: Warm support color. Tiles, business cards, tags. Text on it must be tinta. Never as text.

tokens.name: menta
tokens.usage: Cool support color. Tiles, tags, filament spool rings. Text on it must be tinta. Never as text.

tokens.name: crema
tokens.usage: Base ground for pages and print, and the text color on cobalto and tinta.

tokens.name: blanco
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on crema: cards, browser mockups, logo tiles. Always with a 2px tinta border.

tokens.name: tinta
tokens.usage: Main text on crema, blanco, tomate, mantequilla and menta. Also the dark ground and all borders.

tokens.name: tinta-suave
tokens.usage: Secondary text, eyebrows and captions on crema and blanco (8:1 on crema).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Website headlines. Lowercase or sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headlines on the website, under an eyebrow. 36px on phones. Sentence case, one phrase in cobalto.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps, tag vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between swatches and small tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tile padding, tag horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a section label and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between large cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section top spacing.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Color swatches and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large tiles, browser mockups, logo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and tags.

tokens.name: extrude
tokens.usage: The printed-layer extrusion in tomate. Use on one element per view, the way only the p is extruded in the logo. Square-edged shapes only.
